name: intro-growth
title: Growth (new)
note: One continuous shot: an untangled 2D tree of airports grows, the camera opening out in one planned move (it only widens, its middle following the tree's smoothly, and keeps opening through the arrows up to the lift), lifts into 3D in two moves, more airports arrive scattered through its open spaces and its communities light and gather them into separate lobes, then, as the world darkens, the camera leaves its orbit carrying its own motion on and swoops in behind Chongqing (the take plays the hush 2 times slower and that swoop 9.6/3.1 times slower, and the cut 9.6x, so the restyles there cost no visible frames and the camera's speed carries on unchanged into the flight), flies the route from Chongqing by Sydney and Manila to San Francisco, drawn in red, beside it like an airplane, looking along the route's line ahead as each airport comes up and sweeps by large, its speed building, then bends onto San Francisco and eases into a close-up on it (the flight plays at 3.1x, but for the route line's fade from 2 s to 1.1 s before the close-up: the take plays that stretch 3 times slower so its restyles cost no visible frames, and the cut 9.3x; likewise the pull back's first 6 s of output, while the light comes back, 2 times slower in the take), holds San Francisco briefly while the earth fades in behind it (San Francisco a plain red ball, already at its place on the globe and already exactly the globe's airports' size in the world, never larger; it reads large only because the camera is near), and pulls back to the whole globe, evenly lit, centered between the logo and the tagline (the title card's `gap`), San Francisco easing into one ordinary airport of the globe on the way (its community's color; the globe's airports are plain balls sized in the world, so they shrink together as the camera pulls back and read as fine dots on the end globe). Music is a PLACEHOLDER (audio/trailer.wav, its build lengthened to the crescendo by ~/intros/growth/make-music.sh, which also sets its loudness curve to the cut's marks): the owner has not chosen a track. To swap it, set music.file, and move the logo onto the new track's final hit by shifting Part B's `to` and the title's `over.at` by the same amount (both after mark turn, so the dissolve into the title shows the same frames on both sides).
